name: Processor Idle Disable
description: Disables advanced processor idle states to keep cores fully active
warnings: May increase Temperatures & Power Consumption, CPU will be at 100% in task manager
commands:
powercfg /setacvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor 0 0
powercfg /setdcvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor 0 0
powercfg /setactive scheme_current

powercfg /setdcvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor 0 1
powercfg /setactive scheme_current
revert23H2:

powercfg /setdcvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor 0 1
powercfg /setactive scheme_current
revert24H2:

powercfg /setdcvalueindex scheme_current sub_processor 0 1
